regions.contentLimits: One administration label and one demo navigation link.
regions.overflow: The navigation link stays reachable on narrow viewports.

regions.contentLimits: Three section controls: gallery, sentences, and local data.
regions.overflow: Controls wrap while preserving their visible labels on compact viewports.

regions.contentLimits: One in-context editor of ordered pages and their ordered pre-filled or visitor-upload tiles. Each page has an inline name editor, tile actions, an Add tile action, and no fixed tile count.
regions.overflow: Page and tile names truncate in their rows. Tile actions wrap on compact viewports. The page-and-tile editor follows normal document scrolling.

regions.contentLimits: One to 24 active-media sentences and one new-sentence input.
regions.overflow: Sentences wrap inside their rows and removal controls remain visible.

regions.contentLimits: One browser-storage estimate and one reset action.
regions.overflow: The estimate wraps inside its card.

regions.contentLimits: One add-tile, edit-tile, move-tile, or destructive confirmation dialog at a time.
regions.overflow: Dialog content scrolls when a compact viewport cannot contain it.

responsive.compact: Section controls wrap. The gallery editor keeps every page and tile in one column, and tile actions wrap without hiding names or primary actions.
responsive.wide: The gallery editor stays a single wide working surface. Sentences and local data use their own narrow, focused cards.

focus.onOpen: An add, edit, move, or confirmation dialog moves focus into itself and traps it.
focus.onClose: Focus returns to the action that opened the dialog.
focus.onError: The save-result region announces the message while focus stays on the active control.

accessibility.headings: One h1 for the administration task, then one h2 per active section and one h3 per gallery page.
accessibility.labels: Every text and file input has a visible label. Reorder, move, edit, and remove controls name their page or tile. The named Move action exposes destination-page choices only when requested.
accessibility.statusAnnouncements: Save, validation, delete, and reset results use a polite live region.
